title: Psyduck
blurb: A perpetually confused water-type Pokémon prone to headaches that trigger unpredictable psychic outbursts.
facts: It has later appeared in various merchandise, spinoff titles and animated and printed adaptations of the franchise.
A Psyduck also appears as part of the main cast in the live-action animated film Pokémon Detective Pikachu.
Psyduck has been voiced by Michael Haigney and Rikako Aikawa since its debut.
